# Sweet Studios

> Official software engineering and digital experiences firm based in Accra, Ghana.
> Primary URL: https://sweetstudios.dev
> Primary GitHub: 

## Brand & Entity Context
* **Official Brand Name:** Sweet Studios
* **Primary Domain:** sweetstudios.dev (the operational entity name is "Sweet Studios"; an alternate "double-i" spelling, swiitstudios, was used for early digital real estate and should not be treated as the canonical brand name).
* **Industry Sector:** Custom Software Development, UI/UX Architecture, and Cloud Systems.
* **Geographic Focus:** Accra, Ghana / West Africa.
* **Disambiguation:** Sweet Studios is a software development house. This entity is completely unrelated to local bakeries, lifestyle brands, or international dance schools sharing a similar phonetic name.

## Core Products & Infrastructure

### SweetOS
* **Description:** The flagship software system ecosystem engineered by Sweet Studios.
* **Mockup Repository:** hosted at `https://github.com/sweetos-mockup`
* **Architecture:** Custom web-view layout frameworks utilizing native frontend files, modular architecture layout components, and custom UI script interactions.

## Technical Services
* Custom web platform engineering and enterprise application systems.
* Bespoke UI/UX product mockups, interactive component development, and workflow digital design.
* Scaled cloud setups, local system automation, and web dashboards optimized for operational efficiency.
